40021991.author: पदार्थः
40021991.content: ताम् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, दिव्यसङ्काशां divine-like, कथाम् story, अद्भुतदर्शनाम् amazing to behold, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, परमप्रीतः greatly pleased, राघवम् to Rama, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke

40021991.author: Translation
40021991.content: Having heard that divine-like and amazing story, Lakshmana was greatly pleased and spoke these words to Rama.

40021992.author: पदार्थः
40021992.content: निक्षिप्तदेहौ having abandoned their bodies, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, कथम् how, तौ those two, द्विजपार्थिवौ the Brahmin and the king, पुनर्देहेन again with a body, संयोगम् union, जग्मुः attained, देवसम्मतौ approved by the gods

40021992.author: Translation
40021992.content: Lakshmana asked Rama how those two, the Brahmin and the king, who had abandoned their bodies and were respected by the gods, managed to regain a physical form.

40021993.author: पदार्थः
40021993.content: तस्य his, तत् that, भाषितम् speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामः Rama, सत्यपराक्रमः of true valor, ताम् that, कथाम् story, कथयामास narrated, वसिष्ठस्य of Vasishtha, महात्मनः of the great-souled one

40021993.author: Translation
40021993.content: Having heard Lakshmana's words, Rama, whose valor is truth, then narrated the story of the great-souled Vasishtha.

40021994.author: पदार्थः
40021994.content: यः who, तु indeed, कुम्भः pot, रघुश्रेष्ठ O best of Raghu's lineage, तेजःपूर्णः filled with semen/radiance, महात्मनोः of the two great souls, तस्मिन् in that, तेजोमयौ radiant, विप्रौ two Brahmins, सम्भूतौ were born, ऋषिसत्तमौ two excellent sages.

40021994.author: Translation
40021994.content: O best of Raghu's lineage, in that pot, which was filled with the radiant semen of the two great souls (Mitra and Varuna), two radiant Brahmins, who were excellent sages, were born.

40021995.author: पदार्थः
40021995.content: पूर्वम् first, समभवत् was born, तत्र there, हि indeed, अगस्त्यः Agastya, भगवान् divine, ऋषिः sage, न not, अहम् I, सुतः son, तव your, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, मित्रम् Mitra, तस्मात् from him, अपाक्रमत् departed.

40021995.author: Translation
40021995.content: First, the divine sage Agastya was born there, and having said "I am not your son," Mitra then departed from him.

40021996.author: पदार्थः
40021996.content: तत् that, हि indeed, तेजः semen/radiance, तु but, मित्रस्य of Mitra, उर्वस्याः in Urvashi, पूर्वम् previously, आहितम् placed, तस्मिन् in that, समभवत् was born, कुम्भे in the pot, तत् that, तेजः semen/radiance, यत्र where, वारुणम् of Varuna.

40021996.author: Translation
40021996.content: That semen of Mitra, which had previously been placed in Urvashi, was born in that pot where the semen of Varuna was also present.

40021997.author: पदार्थः
40021997.content: कस्यचित् after some, तु indeed, अथ then, कालस्य time, मित्रावरुणसम्भवः born of Mitra and Varuna, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, तेजसा with radiance, युक्तः endowed, जज्ञे was born, इक्ष्वाकुदैवतम् the deity/priest of Ikshvaku.

40021997.author: Translation
40021997.content: Then, after some time, Vasishtha, born of Mitra and Varuna and endowed with radiance, was born as the priest of Ikshvaku.

40021998.author: पदार्थः
40021998.content: तम् him, इक्ष्वाकुः Ikshvaku, महातेजा exceedingly radiant, जातमात्रम् as soon as born, अनिन्दितम् blameless, वव्रे chose, पुरोधसम् as family priest, सौम्य O gentle one, वंशस्य of the lineage, अस्य this, भवाय for the prosperity, नः our.

40021998.author: Translation
40021998.content: O gentle one, the exceedingly radiant Ikshvaku chose that blameless Vasishtha, as soon as he was born, to be the family priest for the prosperity of our lineage.

40021999.author: पदार्थः
40021999.content: एवं thus, तु indeed, अपूर्वदेहस्य of one with an unprecedented body, वसिष्ठस्य of Vasistha, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, कथितो has been told, निर्गमः the departure, सौम्य O gentle one, निमेः of Nimi, शृणु listen, यथा how, अभवत् it happened.

40021999.author: Translation
40021999.content: O gentle one, thus has been narrated the birth of the great-souled Vasistha, who had an unprecedented body; now listen to how it happened with Nimi.

40022000.author: पदार्थः
40022000.content: दृष्ट्वा having seen, विदेहं bodiless, राजानम् the king, ऋषयः the sages, सर्व all, एव indeed, ते they, तं him, च and, ते they, योजयामासुः made him undertake, यागदीक्षाम् the initiation for the sacrifice, मनीषिणः the wise ones.

40022000.author: Translation
40022000.content: All those wise sages, having seen the king Nimi bodiless, then engaged him in the initiation rites for the sacrifice.

40022001.author: पदार्थः
40022001.content: तं that, च and, देहं body, नरेन्द्रस्य of the king, रक्षन्ति protected, स्म (past tense indicator), द्विजोत्तमाः the best among the twice-born, गन्धैः with fragrances, माल्यैः with garlands, च and, वस्त्रैः with clothes, च and, पौरभृत्यसमन्विताः accompanied by citizens and servants.

40022001.author: Translation
40022001.content: And the best among the twice-born, accompanied by citizens and servants, protected that body of the king with fragrances, garlands, and clothes.

40022002.author: पदार्थः
40022002.content: ततः then, यज्ञे समाप्ते when the sacrifice was concluded, भृगुः Bhrigu, तत्र there, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke, पार्थिव O king, तव तुष्टः अस्मि I am pleased with you, ते your, चेतः consciousness, आनयिष्यामि I shall restore.

40022002.author: Translation
40022002.content: Then, when the sacrifice was concluded, Bhrigu said: O king, I am pleased with you, and I shall restore your consciousness.

40022003.author: पदार्थः
40022003.content: सुप्रीताः very pleased, च and, सुराः the gods, सर्वे all, निमेः to Nimi, चेतः (to his spirit), तथा thus, अब्रुवन् they spoke, वरं a boon, वरय choose, राजर्षे O royal sage, क्व where, ते your, चेतो mind, निरूप्यताम् let it be fixed.

40022003.author: Translation
40022003.content: And all the gods, being very pleased, thus spoke to Nimi's spirit: "O royal sage, choose a boon; where should your mind be fixed?"

40022004.author: पदार्थः
40022004.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, सुरैः by the gods, सर्वैः by all, निमेः Nimi's, चेतः spirit, तदा then, अब्रवीत् spoke, नेत्रेषु in the eyes, सर्वभूतानां of all beings, वसेयं may I dwell, सुरसत्तमाः O best among gods.

40022004.author: Translation
40022004.content: Thus spoken to by all the gods, Nimi's spirit then said: "O best among gods, may I dwell in the eyes of all beings."

40022005.author: पदार्थः
40022005.content: बाढम् certainly, इति thus, एव indeed, विबुधाः the gods, निमेः of Nimi, चेतः to the mind, तदा then, अब्रुवन् spoke, नेत्रेषु in the eyes, सर्वभूतानाम् of all beings, वायुभूतः having become air, चरिष्यसि you will move.

40022005.author: Translation
40022005.content: The gods then spoke to Nimi's spirit, saying, "Indeed, you will move as air within the eyes of all beings."

40022006.author: पदार्थः
40022006.content: त्वत्कृते for your sake, च and, निमिष्यन्ति will blink, चक्षूंषि the eyes, पृथिवीपते O king, वायुभूतेन by you having become air, चरता moving, विश्रमार्थम् for the sake of rest, मुहुर्मुहुः repeatedly.

40022006.author: Translation
40022006.content: O King, for your sake, the eyes will blink repeatedly for rest, as you move within them as air.

40022007.author: पदार्थः
40022007.content: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, तु indeed, विबुधाः the gods, सर्वे all, जग्मुः went, यथागतम् as they had come, ऋषयः the sages, अपि also, महात्मानः great-souled ones, निमेः of Nimi, देहम् the body, समाहरन् gathered.

40022007.author: Translation
40022007.content: Having spoken thus, all the gods departed to their respective abodes, and the great-souled sages then collected Nimi's body.

40022008.author: पदार्थः
40022008.content: अरणिम् the fire-stick, तत्र there, निक्षिप्य having placed, मथनम् churning, चक्रुः they performed, ओजसा with might, मन्त्रहोमैः with mantra-oblations, महात्मानः the great-souled ones, पुत्रहेतोः for the sake of a son, निमेः of Nimi, तदा then.

40022008.author: Translation
40022008.content: Then, the great-souled sages, for the sake of a son for Nimi, placed the fire-stick there and performed churning with might and mantra-oblations.

40022009.author: पदार्थः
40022009.content: अरण्याम् from the fire-stick, मथ्यमानायाम् being churned, प्रादुर्भूतः appeared, महातपाः a great ascetic, मथनात् from churning, मिथिरिति as Mithi, आहुः they called, जननात् from birth, जनकः Janaka, अभवत् became, यस्मात् because, विदेहात् from the bodyless (Nimi), सम्भूतः born, वैदेहः Vaideha, तु indeed, ततः therefore, स्मृतः remembered.

40022009.author: Translation
40022009.content: From the churned fire-stick, a great ascetic appeared, who was called Mithi because of the churning, became Janaka due to his birth, and was known as Vaideha because he was born from the bodyless Nimi.

40022010.author: पदार्थः
40022010.content: एवं thus, विदेहराजः the king of Videha, च and, जनकः Janaka, पूर्वकः the ancestor, अभवत् was, मिथिर्नाम by the name Mithi, महातेजाः greatly effulgent, तेन by him, अयम् this, मैथिलः Maithila, अभवत् became.

40022010.author: Translation
40022010.content: Thus, the ancestor of Janaka, the king of Videha, was the greatly effulgent Mithi, from whom this region became known as Maithila. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तपञ्चाशः सर्गः ।। 57 ।। Thus ends the fifty-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
